summary: Anbio Biotechnology filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a Class A meeting and an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) held on May 15, 2026. Shareholders approved an authorized share capital increase from $0.50 to $3,000, creating new Class C ordinary and preference shares; a voting rights increase for Class B shares from 50 to 500 votes per share; and changes to Class B conversion rights. The moves appear aimed at restructuring share classes and voting control. No price, premium, or special-situation deal terms were disclosed. Watch for potential effects on corporate governance or future capital actions.
